rule_03.rule: Neuter47 nominative/accusative plural takes u for a short stem, zero for a heavy stem; selected syncopating disyllables such as mægen have mægnu. Final long vowels/diphthongs and consonant clusters matter, including palmtwīg and nest.

reason: Cook47.1 explicitly supplies mægnu only for nominative/accusative plural. The earlier all-ending mægn- rule overextended that evidence. Cook47.6 points to43.4, whose ordinary short-stem treatment retains the second vowel. No inspected additional primary witness had been supplied for all four contracted obliques.

maegen.diagnostic_rule: Retain mægen- in genitive/dative singular and plural: mægenes, mægene, mægena, mægenum. Cook47.1 explicitly selects the exceptional nominative/accusative plural mægnu; that plural does not authorize an all-ending mægn- stem. Later contracted obliques require separately identified evidence and are outside this selected table.

andgiet.diagnostic_rule: The already-taught neuter class is reused for the four abstract-singular cells andgiet, andgietes, andgiete, andgiet. Both assigned uses are singular. All plural forms and count/faculty senses are outside this assignment; no defective-noun claim is made. The earlier proposed zero nominative/accusative plural lacked specific evidence and is withdrawn.
andgiet.scope: Reuse of a previously taught noun class: complete four-case singular of this stated mass/abstract sense. The plural lies outside the taught sense and this assignment; this is not a claim that the noun lacks a plural or an introduction of a new noun class.

rule_03.rule: Neuter47 nominative/accusative plural takes u for the stated short monosyllabic model, zero for the heavy model. Disyllables and compounds need their own diagnostic statement rather than automatic assignment from a final spelling. Cook47.1 explicitly lists mægnu in nominative/accusative plural; the selected table retains mægen- in all oblique forms. Final long vowels/diphthongs and consonant clusters matter, including palmtwīg and nest.

andgiet_scope_reason: Cook275 assigns47 and the meanings sense/meaning/understanding but supplies no plural. Both assigned uses38.5 and43.11 are abstract singular. The prior general neuter class is already complete, so teach only the complete four-case singular of these senses. Plural forms and count/faculty senses are outside scope, not claimed impossible. The zero plural of the previous proposal is withdrawn as insufficiently justified.
stable_ids_note: The six corrected/withdrawn morphology decisions leave all existing assigned exercise source IDs and the two actual andgiet singular models unchanged. Retained form IDs remain stable; removed andgiet plural cells are archived in before.andgiet.
